Frontend (mobile 390x844): injected session token into localStorage 'gh_session_token', home renders 4 sections (ZDRAVIE/ANGEL/KOMUNITA/PREŽITIE) plus SAFETY with all 16 cards; all 8 new screens load with expected UI (/wellness, /scam-shield, /survival-auditor, /medicine-cabinet, /barter shows 10 credits, /marketplace, /healthcare-proxy, /family-dashboard); scam-shield end-to-end integration verified: HIGH RISK verdict + 3 reasons + Slovak Jarvis advice + history entry displayed after LLM call.
action_items: OPTIONAL: server.py is now 1544 lines — split into routes/ (auth, wellness, cabinet, market, scam, survival, barter, beacon, proxy, respect) + services/ + models/ for maintainability.

OPTIONAL: The 14+ endpoints still using `authorization: Optional[str] = Header(None)` + manual `get_current_user(authorization)` should be refactored to `user: dict = Depends(get_current_user)` for DRY.

OPTIONAL: Barter accept transfers credits with two separate $inc operations (lines 1451-1452) without a Mongo transaction — under concurrent accepts a race could produce a credit mismatch. Consider a session/transaction or a single atomic $inc pipeline.

OPTIONAL: scam_check returns fallback risk='medium' silently on LLM/JSON parse failure (line 1311-1321); log level is error but the client sees the 'Analýza zlyhala' default without any hint. Consider surfacing a boolean `ai_ok:false` flag in the response.

OPTIONAL: Add testID props on new screen action buttons (ODOSLAŤ, ANALYZOVAŤ, VYGENEROVAŤ DOKUMENT, PRIDAŤ, mood chips) so future Playwright tests can select without falling back to text/role selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: Healthcare Proxy template correctly interpolates DID + SHA-256 hash; hash base includes principal|did|proxy|scope|date — deterministic per user+day, changes if any of these change (good for versioning). Slovak template references Slovak law § 6 ods. 1 písm. b) z.č. 576/2004 Z.z. — legally reasonable citation.
Survival runway correctly enforces family_size floor of 1 (max(1, family_size or 2)) and overall_days = min(water, food) — matches problem statement.
Barter initial credits: _barter_credits lazily initializes any user to BARTER_START_CREDITS=10 on first call — good for B (test verified 10 initial).
cabinet_exchange respond guards against own listing (400) and closed listings (404) — verified.
emergency-qr (public) correctly conditionally includes healthcare_proxy only when proxy_full_name exists — verified via test.
Marketplace DELETE is a soft-delete (active=false) — bookings remain visible in history, which is correct behavior.
Respect Map _merge_metric handles None new values by returning {} (no update), so partial reviews don't skew averages — correct.
